image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an African crocodile's head resting on sandy ground. The image focuses on the textured skin, the eye with a vertical pupil, and the interlocking teeth of the slightly open jaw.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nose, forming a V-shape characteristic of crocodiles rather than the U-shape of alligators. The head structure appears anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple conical teeth are clearly visible. The fourth tooth of the lower jaw appears to fit into a notch on the upper jaw (interlocking), which is a key diagnostic feature.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned high on the skull. A distinct vertical slit pupil is visible. The eye surface has a glossy, protected appearance consistent with a nictitating membrane or corneal reflection.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostril openings are visible at the distal end of the snout, consistent with crocodilian anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While only the head and neck are fully visible, the heavy armor plating extends from the head backwards, implying an elongated armored body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture shows distinct, raised rectangular scales (scutes) with a rough, bony appearance. The arrangement suggests longitudinal rows, though perspective limits full verification of the row continuity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of olive-green, brown, and grey. The texture is highly detailed, showing cracks and ridges typical of osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface (belly) is not visible in this top-down/side-angle close-up of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the camera frame.
